description: Implementation of a stream producer for D3D11 textures in ANGLE, including functions for texture description extraction, validation, and management within the renderer.

classes.name: StreamProducerD3DTexture
classes.description: Class managing D3D11 texture stream production, including validation, description retrieval, and resource management.

methods.name: GetGLDescFromTex
methods.description: Retrieves OpenGL texture description from a D3D11 texture, handling format and size conversions.

methods.name: StreamProducerD3DTexture::validateD3DTexture
methods.description: Validates that a given D3D11 texture is compatible and originated from the renderer.

methods.name: StreamProducerD3DTexture::postD3DTexture
methods.description: Stores a new D3D11 texture and updates related parameters.

methods.name: StreamProducerD3DTexture::getGLFrameDescription
methods.description: Returns the OpenGL description of the current texture frame for a specified plane.

methods.name: StreamProducerD3DTexture::getArraySlice
methods.description: Returns the array slice index of the texture.
